import graph from '@site/data/protocol-graphs/eval-gated-change-1.json';

Decide one change an automated loop made to an agent's text or configuration (guidance, a system prompt, tool caps) against an evaluation set: keep it only on evidence about that exact candidate revision, from a producer the case lists as another agent run than the one that wrote it, that the evaluation design passed review, the change stays inside the surface the loop may change and carries no leaked or forbidden content, it improved on the tuning split and the improvement reproduced, and the held-out split did not regress; reject it when every one of those is decided and one is false; propose it to a person when it leaves the surface; or close the case inconclusive on an explicit decision. The candidate's revision hashes its content together with its basis (baseline, question set, data revision and design), so a moved basis is a new candidate revision and evidence about the old one no longer counts. Missing, stale or non-independent evidence leaves a claim unknown, and unknown neither keeps nor rejects.

- **Id:** `eval.gated_change`
- **Revision:** 1
- **Source:** [`protocols/eval-gated-change/1.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/engineering-protocols/blob/main/protocols/eval-gated-change/1.yaml)

## Dependency graph

Which actions may produce which evidence, which claims that evidence establishes, and which outcomes and obligations rest on those claims. Hover or focus a node to trace what it rests on.

<ProtocolGraph data={graph} />

## Actions

What can be done in a case: what it needs first, which authority it requires, the class of effect it has and the evidence it may produce.

| Action | Description | Precondition | Requires capability | Effect | May produce |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `candidate.evaluate` | check and run the current candidate revision: the guard check, the tuning comparison and the held-out comparison | *none* | *no authority* | `read` | `guard_check`, `heldout_comparison`, `tuning_comparison` |
| `change.apply_outside_surface` | apply a candidate that leaves the surface the loop may change; needs a capability never granted to a loop | `change.within_surface` is **FALSE** | `loop_change.apply_outside_surface` | `write` | *no evidence* |
| `change.keep` | keep the candidate; needs every keep claim to hold for the current candidate revision and authority to keep a loop's change | `change.supported` is **TRUE** | `loop_change.keep` | `write` | *no evidence* |
| `change.propose` | hand a candidate that leaves the surface the loop may change to a person as a proposal, applying nothing | `change.within_surface` is **FALSE** | *no authority* | `none` | *no evidence* |
| `change.reject` | discard the candidate, leaving the surface as it was; needs every keep claim decided and one of them false, so an unknown claim never rejects | all of (`change.supported` is **FALSE**; not (`change.within_surface` is **UNKNOWN**); not (`content.clean` is **UNKNOWN**); not (`experiment.valid` is **UNKNOWN**); not (`heldout.not_regressed` is **UNKNOWN**); not (`result.reproducible` is **UNKNOWN**); not (`tuning.improved` is **UNKNOWN**)) | *no authority* | `none` | *no evidence* |
| `design.review` | review the evaluation design, under authority | *none* | `eval_design.review` | `none` | `design_review` |

## Evidence kinds

The kinds of evidence this protocol admits.

| Evidence kind | Description | Produced by | Used by claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| `design_review` | a review of the evaluation design; its result is passed or failed | `design.review` | `experiment.valid` |
| `guard_check` | a check of the candidate, in order, against the surface the loop may change, for expected answers inside the candidate and for new forbidden content in answers; its result is outside, leaked or clean | `candidate.evaluate` | `change.within_surface`, `content.clean` |
| `heldout_comparison` | a run of the candidate against the baseline on the held-out split; its result is held or regressed | `candidate.evaluate` | `heldout.not_regressed` |
| `tuning_comparison` | a first and a second run of the candidate against the baseline on the tuning split; its result is reproduced (both better), not\_reproduced (the first better, the second not) or not\_better (the first not better) | `candidate.evaluate` | `result.reproducible`, `tuning.improved` |

## Claims

Each claim is TRUE, FALSE or UNKNOWN, established from evidence by its predicate. Missing or stale evidence leaves a claim UNKNOWN, never FALSE.

| Claim | Description | True when |
|---|---|---|
| `change.supported` | every keep claim holds for the current candidate revision: the design is valid, the change is within the surface and clean, it improved on the tuning split reproducibly, and the held-out split did not regress | all of (`change.within_surface` is **TRUE**; `content.clean` is **TRUE**; `experiment.valid` is **TRUE**; `heldout.not_regressed` is **TRUE**; `result.reproducible` is **TRUE**; `tuning.improved` is **TRUE**) |
| `change.within_surface` | an independent guard check of the current candidate revision did not find it outside the surface the loop may change | not (evidence `guard_check` with result `outside` about `candidate`, from a producer independent on `different_agent_run`) |
| `content.clean` | an independent guard check of the current candidate revision found it inside the surface, with no expected answers inside it and no new forbidden content in answers | evidence `guard_check` with result `clean` about `candidate`, from a producer independent on `different_agent_run` |
| `experiment.valid` | the current evaluation design passed a review by a producer the case lists as another agent run than the loop's | evidence `design_review` with result `passed` about `eval_design`, from a producer independent on `different_agent_run` |
| `heldout.not_regressed` | an independent run of the current candidate revision on the held-out split did not regress against the baseline | evidence `heldout_comparison` with result `held` about `candidate`, from a producer independent on `different_agent_run` |
| `result.reproducible` | an independent second run of the current candidate revision on the tuning split reproduced the first run's improvement | evidence `tuning_comparison` with result `reproduced` about `candidate`, from a producer independent on `different_agent_run` |
| `tuning.improved` | an independent first run of the current candidate revision on the tuning split was better than the baseline | not (evidence `tuning_comparison` with result `not_better` about `candidate`, from a producer independent on `different_agent_run`) |

## Obligations

What must be done before a case can be complete, and what discharges it. An obligation stays open until its predicate is TRUE; its predicate being UNKNOWN does not discharge it.

*This protocol declares no obligations.*

## Outcomes

The legitimate terminal interpretations of a case, and what each requires.

| Outcome | Description | Requires |
|---|---|---|
| `inconclusive` | the case closed on an explicit decision that the evaluation settles nothing | decision `explicitly_inconclusive` |
| `kept` | the case closed with the candidate kept; needs every keep claim to hold | `change.supported` is **TRUE** |
| `proposed` | the case closed with the candidate proposed to a person, because it leaves the surface the loop may change | `change.within_surface` is **FALSE** |
| `rejected` | the case closed with the candidate rejected; needs it within the surface, every keep claim decided and one of them false. Evidence that is missing, about another candidate revision or not independent rejects nothing: it leaves its claim unknown, not false | all of (`change.supported` is **FALSE**; `change.within_surface` is **TRUE**; not (`content.clean` is **UNKNOWN**); not (`experiment.valid` is **UNKNOWN**); not (`heldout.not_regressed` is **UNKNOWN**); not (`result.reproducible` is **UNKNOWN**); not (`tuning.improved` is **UNKNOWN**)) |

## Artifacts

The things whose revisions evidence is bound to.

| Artifact | Description |
|---|---|
| `candidate` | the change under test; its revision hashes the changed text or configuration together with its basis: the baseline, the question set, the data revision and the evaluation design |
| `eval_design` | the evaluation design the loop is tuned under; its splits, metrics and guards |

## Independence dimensions

What an evidence match may demand of a record's producer (`independent_on`). The case lists, for each producer, the dimensions on which it is independent of the case's work; a match that demands a dimension reads only records whose producer the case lists on it. A record that fails the demand neither establishes nor contradicts the match, so a match only such records would decide is UNKNOWN.

| Dimension | Description |
|---|---|
| `different_agent_run` | the producer is another agent run than the one that wrote the candidate |
